capabilities: Override fonts for text, interface and monospace
Set font, weight and italic per style and heading level
Search and download Google Fonts into the vault
Use TTF, OTF, WOFF and WOFF2 files from vault, device or installed fonts
Preview changes live and match x-height of mixed fonts
extras: Contacts Google Fonts only for catalog and font downloads; no account, API key or telemetry. Device folders and installed fonts are desktop only and never sync. WOFF2 metadata comes from the file name because Obsidian lacks a Brotli decoder.
problem: Obsidian's built-in font settings only offer a few broad choices, so italic, bold, headings and code cannot use different families or weights.
summary: Font override plugin that sets fonts for note text, interface and monospace, with per-style and per-heading control from Google Fonts or local files.
